method: Explicit reviewed source-entry selection. Composite translations, obvious upstream errors, domain-ambiguous generic terms and questionable correspondences were excluded. Chinese mainland column used directly for NAER two-shore tables. Civil-engineering editorial adaptations are marked per entry. No clinical specialist validation is claimed.
